contradictions.reason: Accepted the supersession and rejection decisions concerning storage conversion and bitfield width. Handicap and unk45 have u8 storage, unk4C has s8 storage, CPU level has u8 storage, more_flags.b5 is one bit and b6 is two bits. An unchanged input at a call boundary does not imply unchanged storage. The absent return in Player_SetFlagsAEBit1 is observable, but its historical cause remains deferred. The human unk45 getter has no unconditional 0–4 guarantee. These distinctions agree with the document and the narrowly scoped proposal.

Collection adds a returned item value to both counters; generation credits the damage source except source 6; the loss path uses signed division by two, updates unk9C and caps the item-routine argument.
